key_features: THE ULTIMATE COLLAGEN DUO: This bundle combines our viral Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask and Collagen Peptide Eye Patches to deliver a complete anti-aging solution. Perfect for those seeking deep hydration, pore tightening, and a radiant Glass Skin glow.

TARGETS DEEP WRINKLES & SMILE LINES: Our Diamond-Embossed Eye Patches are your secret weapon against aging. Specially designed to fit curved areas like smile lines (nasolabial folds) and forehead wrinkles, they deliver concentrated peptides to plump up deep creases and restore elasticity to sagging skin.

PORE CARE & INSTANT FIRMING: While the patches focus on deep lines, the Collagen Mask creates a seamless moisture barrier for the entire face. It visibly minimizes enlarged pores. After use, experience immediate plumping and a smoother texture that makes makeup application flawless.

ADVANCED DIAMOND GEL TECHNOLOGY: Crafted with trusted Made in Korea innovation. The eye patches feature a unique Diamond texture that ensures non-slip adherence and faster nutrient absorption into thin skin, while the mask’s bio-collagen formula penetrates deeply for long-lasting hydration.
